implementation_corrections.impact: All 32 development outcome references checked: none pointed to prior, so existing judgments unchanged. Applied uniformly before freeze and heldout assessment.

interpretation_limits: Automatic source and outcome assessment uses separate contexts of the same model, not independent human gold labels.
Outcome assessor is not given metric scores, call budgets or M11 coefficients, but task content and available evidence can still reveal resource conditions.
Task bootstrap of coefficients is conditional on the selected model family; it is descriptive stability, not a guaranteed confidence interval accounting for all model-selection uncertainty.
Fit target is evidence-supported answer quality, not calibrated correctness probability or hardware success.
Mi/5 normalization and noisy-OR construct remain fixed research assumptions; fitting two coefficients does not validate those assumptions.

assessment_terminal_retry.reason: two technical failures in normal queue; one uniform longer-timeout retry before any fitting

development_completed.reason: lowest task-group leave-one-out error among prospectively specified families; not evidence of universal optimality

report_visual_check.browser_preview: blocked by browser URL security policy; no workaround attempted
report_visual_check.static_checks: HTML parser, duplicate IDs, local artifact links checked

answer_id_sensitivity.reason: 34 of 192 development requirement judgments were downgraded solely because an exact final-answer quote had a wrong answer_event_id. Six additional such cases also failed source checks and remain unverified.
answer_id_sensitivity.correction: Exact non-empty substring in supplied final answer can be canonicalized to run-end; preserve raw ID; no source quote, semantic status or predictor edits.
answer_id_sensitivity.interpretation: Post-development implementation sensitivity, not the originally prespecified primary analysis; no model reruns or score-driven retries.

final_recommendation: No stable improvement established; retain original coefficients as a provisional working baseline; formal Skill unchanged.
